project_name.justification: The text states: "Riverside Resources Inc. ... is pleased to announce it has signed an option agreement to acquire a 100% interest in the Taft Project ('Project')."

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified as "Riverside Resources Inc. (TSXV: RRI) (OTCQB: RVSDF) (FSE: 5YY) ('Riverside' or the 'Company')".

ceo_buyer.justification: The press release is issued on behalf of "'John-Mark Staude' Dr. John-Mark Staude, President & CEO" of Riverside Resources Inc.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The agreement terms state: "As per the Agreement, Riverside can earn a 100% interest in the Taft Project..."

primary_commodity.justification: The project is described as being located in a region prospective for "Rare Earth Elements (REE) and gold mineralization," with the article headline focusing on the "Rare Earth Elements Property Portfolio".

verified_article_link.justification: The article is titled 'Riverside Resources Expands British Columbia Rare Earth Elements Property Portfolio with Taft Project Acquisition' and the source URL is provided at the bottom of the text.

currency.justification: The payment terms are explicitly denominated in Canadian dollars: "...making staged cash payments totaling CAD $125,000 over five years..."

cash_payments_raw.justification: The agreement requires total cash payments of $125,000, composed of staged payments over five years. The text states: "Riverside can earn a 100% interest in the Taft Project by making staged cash payments totaling CAD $125,000 over five years..."

share_payments_raw.justification: The transaction terms outlined in the document consist of cash payments and exploration commitments only; there is no mention of any share payments.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The consideration is explicitly broken down into cash payments and exploration commitments, so a combined value is not applicable.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The transaction terms do not include the issuance of any shares.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: The agreement terms do not mention any share warrants.

option_payments_raw.justification: While the deal is an 'option agreement', the payments are made in cash. There is no mention of stock options being issued as part of the consideration.

issued_share_price.justification: No shares are being issued as part of the transaction, so there is no issued share price.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The exploration commitment is specified as a monetary value, not in meters of drilling.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The agreement includes a commitment for exploration spending: "Additionally, Riverside will commit to a minimum of $320,000 in exploration expenditures over the same period..."

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The text explicitly states that no royalty is involved in the transaction: "This transaction involves no royalties, aligning with Riverside's ongoing commitment to maintaining royalty-free projects."

coverage_area_raw.justification: The text specifies the project's area: "The Project covers a total area of 3,000 hectares (30 km2)..."

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit for the coverage area is given in the text: "The Project covers a total area of 3,000 hectares (30 km2)..."

resource_size.justification: The text describes the project in terms of its potential for discovery, stating it is a "high-potential opportunity to discover critical mineral resources" and that the focus is to "delineate the Rare Earth Element potential". This indicates no formal mineral resource has been defined.

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer, Riverside Resources Inc., is identified with its stock ticker and exchange in the first paragraph: "Riverside Resources Inc. (TSXV: RRI)..."
